excerpt: Just after 9 a.m. on Friday, Feb. 6, 2026, final beams of oxygen ions crashed into one another at nearly the speed of light inside the collider's two house-sized particle detectors, STAR and sPHENIX, marking the end of RHIC's 25th and final run.
title: A Smashing Success: Relativistic Heavy Ion Collider Wraps up Final Collisions
